proposed_scoring.aggregation: ratio_of_means: mean(serial seconds/token across accepted pairs) / mean(mtp seconds/token across accepted pairs)
proposed_scoring.paired_serial_reference: trusted serial K=1 target decode (mtp-probe path) over the same golden, same session, same thermal gate, same box
proposed_scoring.denominator_authority: trusted parent wall time divided by the parent-configured decode total
proposed_scoring.component_floor: aggregate mtp_decode_speedup >= 1.0 (floor applies to the ratio-of-means aggregate, not per pair)
proposed_scoring.bit_exact_gate: every returned token must match the parent-owned serial oracle; any mismatch fails the run before scoring
proposed_scoring.stall_guardrail: a run whose max block latency exceeds 4x its p50 block latency is rejected as measurement-invalid with one gated retry
proposed_scoring.prefill_component: none; seed prefill is charged inside the decode measurement
proposed_scoring.leaderboard: separate gemma4-31b-it-mtp-v1 namespace, never mixed with the serial track
proposed_scoring.measurement_protocol: minimum three accepted thermal-gated pairs per session (target four) with alternating order; single-pair scores are not publishable
